The 'on' and 'rt' letters are empirically anchored by fixture token-with-refresh-openid.json (online, sid present, jti 'onrtcc:') per invariant 12 closing sentence; the 'ro' letter is named in SKILL.md invariant 12 jti-prefix legend and the prediction-target table as the ROPC password discriminator (the unique letter that distinguishes password from cc='client_credentials' / co='authorization_code').

(1) Scope resolution: both requests ask scope=openid; adv3-client's default scopes (web-origins, service_account, acr, profile, roles, basic, email) plus the requested openid optional client scope (which is realm-default-optional, plus openid is the OIDC marker re-attached by DCSC.L188-212 — invariant 2). offline_access is NOT requested by either, so neither session is OFFLINE. (2) Mapper-set assembly: union over allowed scopes, filtered by protocol=openid-connect and isEnabled — not load-bearing for sid/jti. (3) Base claims: initToken sets jti (via encodeTokenId), iss, iat, exp, sid (from userSession.getId()), sub (only if transient — invariant 1). (4) Mapper loop: not relevant — no mapper writes sid or jti. (5) Post-mapper: for CC, OAuth2GrantTypeBase.L128-135 nulls accessToken.sid because (a) useRefreshToken()=false (default for cc, no override on adv3-client) AND (b) encoded session type is TRANSIENT. For password, useRefreshToken()=true at OAuth2GrantTypeBase.java:398, L120 if-branch fires, the L130 transient check is never evaluated, sid retained. The 'rt' (vs 'ft') letter for both: post-mapper.md's existing diagnostic table uses 'rt' for both the transient cc fixture (trrtcc) and the online cc fixture (onrtcc), so the default refresh-token-context tag is 'rt' in this skill's framing — 'ft' (refresh-token-free) is the non-default mode and not in play for either request here.
